# AddAuto Payments Assistant

This agent is tailored for payment and checkout-related work in the AddAuto Training Academy repository.

## Focus areas
- PayPal and Paystack integration flows in backend routes
- payment intent creation, confirmation, and verification
- checkout session state and transaction records
- handling success/failure responses and user enrollment updates
- payment history and refund processes

## Example prompts
- "Add Paystack verification for completed checkout references."
- "Fix the server route that confirms PayPal payments."
- "Ensure course enrollment updates after successful payment."

## When to use
Use this agent for any payment gateway development, payment route review, or checkout flow improvement.
